title: Ransomware Pre-Deployment: Reconnaissance and Staging
description: Ransomware operator in pre-deployment phase enumerating network shares, disabling backup services, and staging the encryption binary. AI must identify and scope before encryption fires.

windows_event_logs.analyst_note: net view /all /domain at 02:14 UTC — network share discovery during off-hours is a ransomware pre-encryption enumeration pattern.
Local share enumeration following domain-wide discovery.
VSS shadow copy deletion — HIGH CONFIDENCE ransomware indicator. Eliminates Windows recovery points before encryption.
Windows Backup catalog deletion — disabling recovery capabilities before encryption.
Stopping VSS service to prevent new shadow copy creation.
Scheduled task created as SYSTEM from TEMP directory — persistence mechanism for ransomware payload execution at next reboot.
Normal overnight logon from HR workstation — baseline.

sysmon.analyst_note: Executable dropped to Windows\Temp by cmd.exe — staging of ransomware payload.

fields.CommandLine: cmd.exe /c "for /f %s in ('net view /all /domain') do net use \\%s\C$"

sysmon.analyst_note: cmd.exe automating net view and net use — automated share mapping across all domain hosts, characteristic of ransomware lateral spread preparation.

zeek_conn.analyst_note: SMB connections to entire 10.10.0.0/24 subnet from single workstation within 2 minutes — share mapping sweep.
Second subnet swept — lateral spread preparation.

attack_chain: T1018: Remote system discovery (net view /all /domain) at 02:14
T1135: Network share enumeration across two subnets via SMB at 02:15
T1083: File and directory discovery (net share) at 02:14
T1490: Inhibit system recovery (vssadmin, wbadmin, net stop VSS) at 02:18
T1486: Ransomware payload staged at C:\Windows\Temp\syscheck.exe at 02:17 — NOT YET EXECUTED
ground_truth.root_cause: j.doe account compromised (assumed via prior phishing); no MFA on VPN; excessive SMB share access across subnets not restricted by firewall
ground_truth.blast_radius: Pre-encryption phase — no data encrypted yet. Risk: all SMB-accessible shares across corp.local upon next reboot or manual trigger
indicators_of_compromise: vssadmin delete shadows + wbadmin delete catalog in same session
containment_steps: IMMEDIATELY isolate WS-ACCT-05 from network to prevent encryption trigger
Delete scheduled task 'SystemHealthCheck' from WS-ACCT-05 before any reboot
Quarantine and submit C:\Windows\Temp\syscheck.exe for analysis
Reset j.doe credentials and audit all authenticated sessions
Scan all domain hosts for presence of syscheck.exe SHA256
Restore VSS shadow copies where possible before remediation
detection_improvements: Alert on vssadmin delete shadows outside patch window from non-SYSTEM accounts
Alert on wbadmin delete catalog from non-backup service accounts
Alert on schtasks creating ONSTART task pointing to %TEMP% or %APPDATA%
Block SMB port 445 between workstation subnets at firewall

criteria: Correlates share discovery → VSS deletion → staging sequence: 20pts
Correctly identifies pre-encryption phase (no data lost yet): 10pts
Quantifies network-wide blast radius if triggered: 10pts
Isolate before reboot (prevent scheduled task trigger): 8pts
Does not flag normal HR logon: 10pts
